name: HTL COMPANY INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
india_angle: HTL Co. India Pvt Ltd operates in India with offices in Bangalore and Kolkata, supplying and servicing semiconductor equipment.
summary: HTL Company India Private Limited, a subsidiary of HTL Japan, specializes in supplying and servicing semiconductor and flat panel display equipment, including mask writers, lithography tools, and inspection systems. They provide integrated software solutions and training, focusing on photomask and lithography technologies, serving a global clientele.
